The '''2019 Copa Sudamericana second stage''' was played from 21 to 30 May 2019.<ref name="calendar">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2019_divulgacao_aprobado_14_08_2018_0.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2019 CONMEBOL Libertadores – CONMEBOL Sudamericana – RECOPA|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the second stage to decide the 16 places in the [[2019 Copa Sudamericana final stages|final stages]] of the [[2019 Copa Sudamericana]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/reglamento-conmebol-sudamericana-2019-esp.pdf|title=Reglamento CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2019|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=Spanish}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the second stage was held on 13 May 2019, 20:30 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−04:00|UTC−4]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/los-cruces-de-la-segunda-fase-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana|title=Los cruces de la Segunda Fase de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=13 May 2019}}</ref> For the second stage, the teams were allocated to two pots according to their previous results in this season:<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/bolilleros-listos-para-el-sorteo-de-segunda-fase-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana|title=Bolilleros listos para el sorteo de Segunda Fase de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=10 May 2019|language=es}}</ref>
*'''Pot 1:''' 10 teams transferred from the Copa Libertadores and six best winners of the first stage from the Copa Sudamericana
*'''Pot 2:''' 16 remaining winners of the first stage from the Copa Sudamericana
The 32 teams were drawn into 16 ties (O1–O16) between a team from Pot 1 and a team from Pot 2, with the teams from Pot 1 hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association could be drawn into the same tie.<section end=Draw />

The following were the 10 teams transferred from the [[2019 Copa Libertadores|Copa Libertadores]] (two [[2019 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages#Copa Sudamericana qualification|best teams]] eliminated in the [[2019 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages#Third stage|third stage]] of [[2019 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages|qualifying]] and eight third-placed teams in the [[2019 Copa Libertadores group stage|group stage]]).

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the second stage, each tie was played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis. If tied on aggregate, the [[away goals rule]] was used. If still tied, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] was not played, and a [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] was used to determine the winner (Regulations Article 27).<ref name="regulations"/>

The 16 winners of the second stage advanced to the [[2019 Copa Sudamericana final stages#Round of 16|round of 16]] of the [[2019 Copa Sudamericana final stages|final stages]].<section end=Format />

==Matches==
The first legs were played on 21–23 May, and the second legs were played on 28–30 May 2019.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/el-calendario-de-partidos-de-la-segunda-fase-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana|title=El calendario de partidos de la Segunda Fase de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=14 May 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/fixture_sudamericana_segunda_fase_14_05_2019.pdf|title=PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS - SEGUNDA FASE|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>
